# Testing a package that simd depends on makes the go command compile a test
# variant of it, which a rewritten package (it imports simd) cannot link against.
# The go command compiles packages concurrently, so the variant may not exist yet
# when another package is compiled: the wrapper reads the go command's command line
# and rewrites nothing in a build that tests such a package. internal/fuzz, which
# every test binary links (through testing/internal/testdeps) and which imports
# strconv, has a loop the wrapper would rewrite, and the test binary must still
# link and pass.

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
env LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC_LOG=$WORK/log
env LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC_DEBUG=1
env LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC_LOG_PKGS=internal/fuzz
exec go test -short -run 'TestAtoi|TestItoa' -toolexec=$LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC strconv
stdout -count=1 '^ok  	strconv	'
cmp log log.want

# Testing a package simd does not depend on is not affected: the same package is
# rewritten again once the tested package is one the wrapper may link against.
env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache2
env LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC_LOG_PKGS=testing/iotest
rm log
exec go test -short -run 'TestReader|TestOneByte' -toolexec=$LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC testing/iotest
stdout -count=1 '^ok  	testing/iotest	'
grep '^rewrote [0-9]+ loop.s. in testing/iotest$' log

# Rewriting nothing in the build is not enough on its own: the go command would
# reuse the rewritten packages an earlier build left in the cache, and any of
# them in the test binary links simd, which was built against the other strconv.
# The wrapper's build identity differs in such a build, so the cached rewrites are
# not taken. On a toolchain where os is not a simd dependency, building it
# rewrites internal/filepathlite, which every test binary links.
env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache3
env LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC_LOG_PKGS=
rm log
exec go build -toolexec=$LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC os
exec go test -short -run 'TestAtoi|TestItoa' -toolexec=$LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC strconv
stdout -count=1 '^ok  	strconv	'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.27.4
-- log.want --
skipped internal/fuzz: the build tests a package simd depends on
